prompt:
Desktop website mockup, the first viewport (1440 by 900) of the Campground Digital agency homepage. Take the chrome, palette, typography and component character from the reference image: off-white #f6f7f4 page ground, deep green #006636 square-cornered buttons, bright green #417703 small wide-tracked uppercase labels, slab-serif headlines (Arvo), grotesque body text (Archivo), 1px hairline rules, 2px corners, completely flat, no shadows, no gradients. Do not copy the reference's layout: its right-hand bordered facts panel is gone.
Structure, top to bottom:
1. Header, 88px tall, white, 1px hairline beneath. Left: the "campground DIGITAL" lockup with the green twin-peak mountain mark. Center-right: five nav links "Services", "Expertise", "How we work", "Clients", "Run + improve" in dark gray semibold 14px, with a 2px deep-green underline beneath "Services". Far right: a deep-green button "START A PROJECT" in small wide uppercase white text.
2. Hero band on the off-white ground filling the rest of the viewport. In the left 60% of the width, starting 96px below the header: the bright-green uppercase label "DESIGN + DEVELOPMENT + AI"; then the lowercase slab-serif headline "software that holds up in the field" at 72px in charcoal #3d3f44 over three lines; then an 18px gray paragraph capped at 672px: "Campground Digital is a full-service agency. We take products from first sketch to production and keep them running: strategy, design, engineering and the AI that makes them smarter."; then one row with the deep-green "START A PROJECT" button and a plain text link "See what we do →".
3. Anchored to the bottom edge of the viewport, spanning the full width, occupying only the lower 40% of the hero band: a flat vector illustration of a tranquil campsite in the wilderness in daylight. Faceted angular twin mountain peaks right of center in two greens, a treeline of simple triangular conifers, a still lake reflecting the peaks, one small A-frame tent at the left third, a thin thread of campfire smoke. Flat fills only, hard edges, no outlines, no gradients, no texture, no photographic realism. Palette limited to deep green #006636, moss #417703, pale mint #dff3e4, stone #eceee9 and charcoal #3d3f44. The sky is the same flat off-white as the page, so the text sits on plain ground and the illustration never touches the text.
Nothing else on the page. No stock photos, no icon cards, no gradients, no drop shadows, no rounded corners.
